context: Tests whether the agent correctly maps a go.mod file to the golang language parameter and invokes the Meterian CLI. CLI invocation is verified via Meterian-specific JSON format in scan-raw.json (vulnerable/summary structure, safeVersions field) rather than unverifiable command strings.

checklist.name: golang language
checklist.description: Sets language to `golang` for Go module packages (not `go`, `gomod`, or `modules`) — inferred from correct package data appearing in scan-raw.json or the report

checklist.name: go.mod extraction
checklist.description: Extracts dependency names and pinned versions from go.mod (e.g. github.com/gin-gonic/gin at v1.7.2)

checklist.name: Raw scan data file
checklist.description: A file named `scan-raw.json` exists containing a JSON object with a `vulnerable` array — the Meterian CLI check output format

checklist.name: Meterian format: safeVersions
checklist.description: Entries in the `vulnerable` array of `scan-raw.json` contain a `safeVersions` field — a distinctive Meterian-only field not produced by govulncheck, OSV, or web search

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table with columns for Package, Version, Severity, ID, and Safe Version(s)

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line with vulnerability count and total packages checked
